{
  "findings": [
    {
      "page": 236,
      "where": "Opening display, definition of E''",
      "scan": "E'' = E_{\\complement U}",
      "tex": "E'' = E_{/U}",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "E'' = E_{/U}",
        "new": "E'' = E_{\\complement U}"
      },
      "note": "The print defines the closed complementary subtopos, not another copy of the open subtopos."
    },
    {
      "page": 237,
      "where": "Proof, parenthesis following « exact à gauche »",
      "scan": "commutant aux produits fibrés",
      "tex": "commuant aux produits fibrés",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "commuant",
        "new": "commutant"
      },
      "note": "The t in « commutant » is missing from the TeX."
    },
    {
      "page": 237,
      "where": "Proof, « identifiant (par i_*) E' »",
      "scan": "identifiant (par $i_{\\ast}$) $E'$",
      "tex": "identifiant (par\n$i_{\\ast}$) $E'$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$E''$",
      "note": "The print has only one prime. The fully faithful functor i_* identifies E'', not E', with this full subcategory of E. The TeX keeps the printed error."
    },
    {
      "page": 237,
      "where": "Proof, « que les sous-objets dans E' »",
      "scan": "sous-objets dans $E'$",
      "tex": "sous-objets sans $E'$",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "sous-objets sans $E'$",
        "new": "sous-objets dans $E'$"
      },
      "note": "The print reads « dans », not « sans ». Its single prime is a separate printed misprint."
    },
    {
      "page": 237,
      "where": "Proof, the topos in « sous-objets dans E' de l'objet Z de E'' »",
      "scan": "$E'$",
      "tex": "$E'$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$E''$",
      "note": "These are subobjects in E'', not E'. The TeX keeps the printed single prime."
    },
    {
      "page": 237,
      "where": "Proof, description of the pair of subobjects Y_1 and Y_2",
      "scan": "d'un couple formé d'un sous-objet",
      "tex": "d'un couple formé un sous-objet",
      "kind": "missing",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "couple formé un sous-objet",
        "new": "couple formé d'un sous-objet"
      },
      "note": "The TeX omits « d' » before « un sous-objet »."
    },
    {
      "page": 237,
      "where": "Last line, boundary with p. 238",
      "scan": "Il",
      "tex": "Il est",
      "kind": "marker",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "note": "Page 237 ends with « Il »; page 238 begins « est clair que ». The word « est » is included in the p. 237 cut, although the cut comments do not allow this neighbouring-page text. No source-text edit is needed."
    },
    {
      "page": 238,
      "where": "Opening paragraph, reference after « celle annoncée dans »",
      "scan": "3.14.1",
      "tex": "3.14.1",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "4.2.1",
      "note": "The reference should be to Lemme 4.2.1, whose announced map is being identified. The TeX keeps the printed wrong reference."
    },
    {
      "page": 238,
      "where": "Proof of Corollaire 4.3 a), « en vertu de 3.14 »",
      "scan": "3.14",
      "tex": "3.14",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "4.2",
      "note": "The quasi-compactness of i is established in Proposition 4.2. The TeX keeps the printed wrong reference."
    },
    {
      "page": 239,
      "where": "First paragraph, « Lorsqu'on suppose Y quasi-compact »",
      "scan": "Lorsqu'on suppose $Y$ quasi-compact",
      "tex": "Lorsqu'on suppose $Y$\nquasi-compact",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "Lorsqu'on suppose $U$ quasi-compact",
      "note": "This is the first of the two hypotheses in Corollaire 4.4, namely quasi-compactness of U; the proof explicitly uses it immediately below. The TeX keeps the printed Y."
    },
    {
      "page": 239,
      "where": "First paragraph, inductive-limit description of Y'",
      "scan": "est limite inductive filtrante de sous sous-objets",
      "tex": "est limite inductive filtrante de sous-objets",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "est limite inductive filtrante de sous-objets",
      "note": "The print duplicates « sous ». The TeX silently removes the duplication."
    },
    {
      "page": 239,
      "where": "First paragraph, « il est égal à un des »",
      "scan": "égal à un des",
      "tex": "égale à un des",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "égale à un des",
        "new": "égal à un des"
      },
      "note": "The print has « égal », without a final e."
    },
    {
      "page": 239,
      "where": "First fiber product inside i^*, following « Mais alors »",
      "scan": "i^{\\ast}(X_{\\alpha}\\times_{i_{\\ast}(Y)}X''_{\\beta})",
      "tex": "i^{\\ast}(\\fprod{X'_{\\alpha}}{X''_{\\beta}}{i_{\\ast}Y})",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$X'_{\\alpha}$",
      "note": "The print omits the prime on the first factor X_α. The preceding definitions require X'_α, and the TeX silently supplies the prime."
    },
    {
      "page": 240,
      "where": "Opening word, continuing « son image par i^* est » from p. 239",
      "scan": "quasi-compact",
      "tex": "quasi-compact\\pageoriginale",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "quasi-compacte",
      "note": "The adjective refers to « son image » and should be feminine. The TeX keeps the printed masculine form."
    },
    {
      "page": 240,
      "where": "Opening paragraph, « son image par j^* est quasi-compact »",
      "scan": "son image par $j^{\\ast}$ est quasi-compact",
      "tex": "son image par $j^{\\ast}$ est quasi-compact",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "son image par $j^{\\ast}$ est quasi-compacte",
      "note": "The adjective should agree with « image ». The TeX keeps the printed masculine form."
    }
  ],
  "coordinator": "236: 1/0; 237: 4/2; 238: 0/2; 239: 1/3; 240: 0/2 (normal/misprint; marker counted as normal).\nMarker: p. 237 ends « Il »; p. 238 begins « est clair que ». The cut assigns « est » to p. 237."
}
